headlines.title: Datadog (DDOG) Rallies On AI Demand, Is The Stock Still Cheap?
headlines.summary: Datadog (DDOG) has drawn fresh attention after recent gains left the stock up 15.2% over the past month and 7.2% in the past 3 months, sharply outpacing many software peers. Short term momentum has picked up for Datadog, with a 1 day share price return of 2.16% building on a 7 day gain of 8.86% and contributing to a 92.06% year to date share price return, while the 3 year total shareholder return of 188.80% points to a strong longer run track record.

headlines.title: AutonomyAI Launches Autonomous Product Delivery: From Product Question to Review-Ready Pull Request
headlines.summary: The coding bottleneck is disappearing. The product backlog is not. AutonomyAI, the OS for product teams building in production, today launched Discover Mode, the final piece of its Autonomous Product Delivery system. A product manager can now take a question about what to improve, or allow the AI to suggest improvements, research it across the company's own data, turn the findings into a plan and generate the code. The work lands in the engineering queue as a review-ready pull request.

headlines.title: Datadog (DDOG) Gains As Market Dips: What You Should Know
headlines.summary: In the closing of the recent trading day, Datadog (DDOG) stood at $251.49, denoting a +1.62% move from the preceding trading day.

headlines.title: Fastly Soars 14% on AI Firewall Launch; Cloudflare Climbs 7%, Datadog Rises 5%
headlines.summary: Fastly launched new AI traffic controls this morning and the whole edge security category moved with it, including rivals that announced nothing at all. The question buyers are not asking loudly enough is whether availability and adoption are the same thing.

description: Datadog, Inc. operates an observability and security platform for cloud applications in the United States and internationally. The company's products comprise infrastructure and application performance monitoring, log management, observability pipelines, synthetics, real user monitoring, product analytics, continuous profiler, database monitoring, data observability, LLM observability, error tracking, network monitoring, incident response, workflow automation and App builder, event management, bits AI SRE, cloud cost management, cloud security, code security, cloud SIEM, threat management, sensitive data scanner, and CI visibility. Datadog, Inc. was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in New York, New York.
